landing.title:
Gift exactly
what they want
landing.tagline: Create a wishlist, share a link with friends. They pick and reserve gifts — without spoiling the surprise.
landing.note: Free to use · No account needed to view

steps.title: Create a wishlist
steps.body: Add items by pasting a product URL or typing manually. Wishpicks pulls the title, image and price automatically.

steps.title: Share your link
steps.body: Copy your unique wishlist link and send it to anyone — via messenger, email or socials. No app required.

steps.title: Friends reserve gifts
steps.body: Guests open the link and mark items as reserved. You never see who picked what — the surprise stays intact.

features.title: Surprise stays safe
features.body: The wishlist owner never sees reservation status. Only guests can see what's been picked.

features.title: Share without signing up
features.body: Anyone with the link can view and reserve. No account needed for guests.

features.title: URL auto-import
features.body: Paste any product link — Wishpicks fetches the name, photo and price for you.

features.title: Save others' lists
features.body: Authenticated users can bookmark a friend's wishlist or save individual items to their own collection.

landing.privacy_body: Reservations are visible only to other guests — never to the list owner. The element of surprise is preserved by design, not by trust.
landing.cta_sub: It takes less than two minutes.
landing.preview_note: Tap an item to reserve it — the owner will never know it was you.
